packageRules.description: The jakarta.validation test stack must stay on the Java 11 line, because owner-extras is tested on every LTS from 11 while these artifacts moved to Java 17. Hibernate Validator 9 is class file version 61 and dies on JDK 11 with UnsupportedClassVersionError; Expressly 6 declares Require-Capability JavaSE 17 and takes Hibernate Validator down with it, since it needs an expression language to interpolate messages. Neither limits what a user may put on their own class path: OWNER names only the jakarta.validation API and never a provider.

bval-jsr 2.x is the javax.validation provider and 3.x is the jakarta one. owner-extras tests both namespaces and needs one provider for each, so raising this turns the javax half into a second jakarta provider and stops testing it. Hibernate Validator covers jakarta; this covers javax; they must not become the same thing.
